words.description: Hedefi yavaşça kovalar, ısırırsa 1 can gider.
words.descriptionEn: Slowly chases the target; a bite costs 1 life.

words.description: 5 arı hedefin etrafında döner, küçük hasar verir.
words.descriptionEn: 5 bees circle the target and deal small damage.

words.description: Ayaklara dolanır, hedef 3 sn yavaşlar.
words.descriptionEn: Gets tangled around the feet; the target is slowed for 3 s.

words.description: Gökten dev yumruk iner, hedefi fırlatır.
words.descriptionEn: A giant fist comes down from the sky and sends the target flying.

words.description: Hedefin önüne düşer, basan kayar.
words.descriptionEn: Drops in front of the target; whoever steps on it slips.

words.description: Hızlı ama 8 sn sonra sıkılıp gider.
words.descriptionEn: Fast, but gets bored and leaves after 8 s.

words.description: Hedefin üstünde yağmur yağdırır, hareket yavaşlar.
words.descriptionEn: Rains on the target and slows its movement.

words.description: Komik derecede yavaş, ama değerse 2 can gider.
words.descriptionEn: Comically slow, but costs 2 lives if it touches you.

words.description: Hedefi 4 sn boyunca merkeze çeker.
words.descriptionEn: Pulls the target toward the center for 4 s.

words.description: Hedefin yanına düşer, 3 sn sonra patlar.
words.descriptionEn: Lands next to the target and explodes after 3 s.

words.description: Hedefin olduğu yere alev düşer: hasar verir ve tahtaları tutuşturur, yangın yayılır.
words.descriptionEn: Flames fall where the target stands: deals damage and ignites wooden planks, and the fire spreads.

words.description: Dev bir canavar en yakındakine saldırır ve savurur. Herkes Boşluk ile vurup 12 canını eritmeli; son vuran +1 can kazanır.
words.descriptionEn: A giant monster attacks and flings the nearest player. Everyone must hit it with Space to wear down its 12 HP; the last hitter gains +1 life.

words.description: 3 ok: Boşluk ile ateş et, her isabet 1 can götürür.
words.descriptionEn: 3 arrows: fire with Space, each hit takes 1 life.

words.description: 2 bumerang fırlat, her isabet 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: Throw 2 boomerangs, each hit takes 1 life.

words.description: Çok hızlı tek ışın: değdiği 2 can kaybeder.
words.descriptionEn: A single, very fast beam: whoever it hits loses 2 lives.

words.description: Tek ama çok hızlı mermi: vurduğun elenir.
words.descriptionEn: A single but very fast bullet: whoever you hit is eliminated.

words.description: 5 kartopu: herkese at, her isabet 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: 5 snowballs: throw them at anyone, each hit takes 1 life.

words.description: 3 taş at, her isabet 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: Throw 3 stones, each hit takes 1 life.

words.description: Dev goril en yakındakini savurur. Hep birlikte 14 vuruşta indirin; son vuran +1 can.
words.descriptionEn: A giant gorilla flings the nearest player. Take it down together in 14 hits; the last hitter gains +1 life.

words.description: Yavaş ama çok sağlam robot: 16 vuruş ister.
words.descriptionEn: A slow but very sturdy robot: takes 16 hits.

words.description: Vurduğunu donduran kar canavarı: 10 vuruşta yenilir.
words.descriptionEn: A snow monster that freezes whoever it hits: defeated in 10 hits.

words.description: Hızlı dev örümcek ısırınca yavaşlatır: 8 vuruşta ölür.
words.descriptionEn: A fast giant spider whose bite slows you: dies in 8 hits.

words.description: Koca sopalı dev: çok yavaş ama 18 vuruş ister.
words.descriptionEn: A giant with a huge club: very slow, but takes 18 hits.

words.description: Hızlı dinozor: 10 vuruşta yenilir.
words.descriptionEn: A fast dinosaur: defeated in 10 hits.

words.description: Hızlı aslan: vur-kaç yapar, çarptığını savurur.
words.descriptionEn: A fast lion: hits and runs, flinging whoever it rams.

words.description: Zehirli ısırık: 1 can ve yavaşlama.
words.descriptionEn: Venomous bite: 1 life and a slowdown.

words.description: Duvarlardan geçen hayalet seni yavaşça kovalar.
words.descriptionEn: A ghost that passes through walls slowly chases you.

words.description: Bıkmayan vampir: kaçamazsan tekrar tekrar ısırır.
words.descriptionEn: A relentless vampire: if you can't escape, it bites again and again.

words.description: 4 yarasalık sürü hedefe dalar.
words.descriptionEn: A swarm of 4 bats dives at the target.

words.description: 8 karınca yavaş ama her yerden gelir.
words.descriptionEn: 8 ants: slow, but they come from everywhere.

words.description: Sinek sürüsü can almaz ama vızıldayıp yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: A swarm of flies takes no lives but buzzes around and slows you.

words.description: Hızla dalıp savurur: lav ya da uçurum yanındaysan dikkat!
words.descriptionEn: Charges in fast and flings you: careful if you're near lava or a cliff!

words.description: Gölgeden gelir, vurur ve kaybolur.
words.descriptionEn: Comes out of the shadows, strikes and vanishes.

words.description: Çok yavaş ama yakalarsa 2 can gider.
words.descriptionEn: Very slow, but if it catches you, you lose 2 lives.

words.description: Bir saniye sonra hedefin olduğu yere yıldırım düşer.
words.descriptionEn: One second later, lightning strikes where the target stands.

words.description: Hedefin yanına gizli mayın: basan 1 can kaybeder ve savrulur.
words.descriptionEn: A hidden mine next to the target: whoever steps on it loses 1 life and is flung.

words.description: Yapışkan ağ: basan 4 saniye yavaşlar.
words.descriptionEn: A sticky web: whoever steps on it is slowed for 4 seconds.

words.description: Hedefin çevresindeki herkesi savurur: lava, uçuruma dikkat!
words.descriptionEn: Flings everyone around the target: watch out for lava and cliffs!

words.description: Hedefi izleyen toz bulutu içindekileri yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: A dust cloud follows the target and slows everyone inside it.

words.description: Hedefin çevresi donar: içindekiler 4 saniye yavaşlar.
words.descriptionEn: The area around the target freezes: everyone inside is slowed for 4 seconds.

words.description: 2 saniye sonra hedefin yanına roket düşer: 2 can ve savrulma.
words.descriptionEn: 2 seconds later a rocket lands next to the target: 2 lives and knockback.

words.description: 9 saniye çok hızlı uç: yerdeki tehlikeler sana değmez.
words.descriptionEn: Fly very fast for 9 seconds: ground hazards can't touch you.

words.description: Önüne uzun bir kale duvarı dikersin.
words.descriptionEn: You raise a long castle wall in front of you.

words.description: 9 saniye çalıya dönüşürsün: kimse seni hedef seçemez.
words.descriptionEn: You turn into a bush for 9 seconds: no one can target you.

words.description: 8 sn geri sayımdan sonra dışarıdaki herkes elenir.
words.descriptionEn: After an 8 s countdown, everyone outside is eliminated.

words.description: Haritanın bir kenarından dev dalga gelir.
words.descriptionEn: A giant wave rolls in from one edge of the map.

words.description: 7 sn sonra kenardan uçarak gelir, 10 sn boyunca en yakınındakini kovalayıp ateş püskürtür. Mağaraya sığınana ateşi işlemez.
words.descriptionEn: Flies in from the edge after 7 s and chases the nearest player for 10 s, breathing fire. Its fire cannot reach anyone sheltering in a cave.

words.description: Yere düşecek yerlerde gölge belirir.
words.descriptionEn: Shadows appear where they will hit the ground.

words.description: 20 zombi kenarlardan girer, en yakınındakine saldırır (10 sn).
words.descriptionEn: 20 zombies come in from the edges and attack the nearest player (10 s).

words.description: Bir sonraki hasarı engeller.
words.descriptionEn: Blocks the next damage.

words.description: 1 can geri verir (en fazla başlangıç canı kadar).
words.descriptionEn: Restores 1 life (up to your starting lives).

words.description: Önüne 10 sn duran bir duvar örer.
words.descriptionEn: Builds a wall in front of you that lasts 10 s.

words.description: 8 sn boyunca uçma, yerdeki saldırıları geçer.
words.descriptionEn: Fly for 8 s, passing over ground attacks.

words.description: Elenenlerden rastgele biri 1 canla yeniden doğar.
words.descriptionEn: A random eliminated player respawns with 1 life.

words.description: Yazana tek mermili bir silah verir. Boşluk ile baktığın yöne ateş et: vurduğun elenir (kalkan korur, duvar durdurur).
words.descriptionEn: Gives the writer a gun with a single bullet. Fire where you're facing with Space: whoever you hit is eliminated (a shield protects, a wall stops it).

words.description: 6 mermili tabanca: Boşluk ile ateş et, her isabet 1 can götürür.
words.descriptionEn: A 6-shot pistol: fire with Space, each hit takes 1 life.

words.description: 2 vuruşluk kılıç: Boşluk ile önündekine 2 hasar. Savurmadan önce kılıç parlar, kaçılabilir (kalkan korur).
words.descriptionEn: A 2-swing sword: Space deals 2 damage to whoever is in front of you. The blade glows before the swing, so it can be dodged (a shield protects).

words.description: 2 vuruşluk çivili sopa: Boşluk ile önündekine 2 hasar. Savurmadan önce parlar, kaçılabilir (kalkan korur).
words.descriptionEn: A 2-swing spiked club: 2 damage to whoever is in front of you with Space. It glows before the swing, so it can be dodged (a shield protects).

words.description: 8 saniye çok hızlı motor: hiç durmaz, 2 kişiyi ezince durur. Eve çarparsan patlarsın!
words.descriptionEn: A very fast motorcycle for 8 seconds: it never stops until it runs over 2 people. Crash into a house and you explode!

words.description: 10 saniye geniş araba: hiç durmaz, ilk çarptığını ezip durur. Eve çarparsan patlarsın!
words.descriptionEn: A wide car for 10 seconds: it never stops until it runs over the first person it hits. Crash into a house and you explode!

words.description: 8 sn boyunca hedef alınamazsın.
words.descriptionEn: You can't be targeted for 8 s.

words.description: Hızlı köpek: ısırır, geri çekilir, yine saldırır.
words.descriptionEn: A fast dog: bites, backs off, attacks again.

words.description: Çevik kedi: tırmalar, yavaşlatır, kaçar.
words.descriptionEn: An agile cat: scratches, slows you, runs away.

words.description: Zırhlı timsah: yavaş ama ısırığı 2 can.
words.descriptionEn: An armored crocodile: slow, but its bite costs 2 lives.

words.description: İri ayı: vurduğunu savurur.
words.descriptionEn: A big bear: flings whoever it hits.

words.description: Yavaş ama durmayan iskelet.
words.descriptionEn: A slow but relentless skeleton.

words.description: Uçan cadı: vurduğunu büyüyle yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: A flying witch: slows whoever she hits with a spell.

words.description: Korsan: saldırır, kaçar, yine gelir.
words.descriptionEn: Pirate: attacks, runs off, comes back again.

words.description: Gökten pike yapan kartal.
words.descriptionEn: An eagle that dives from the sky.

words.description: Zehirli akrep: soktuğunu yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: A venomous scorpion: slows whoever it stings.

words.description: Her yerden fışkıran böcek sürüsü.
words.descriptionEn: A swarm of bugs bursting out from everywhere.

words.description: Aç piranha sürüsü.
words.descriptionEn: A school of hungry piranhas.

words.description: Kovan patladı: 6 arı saldırıyor.
words.descriptionEn: The hive burst open: 6 bees are attacking.

words.description: Dev kraken: kollarıyla yavaşlatır. Hep birlikte döv!
words.descriptionEn: A giant kraken: slows you with its tentacles. Beat it up together!

words.description: Dev ayı: savurarak ezer. Son vuran can kazanır.
words.descriptionEn: A giant bear: crushes and flings. The last hitter gains a life.

words.description: Hedefi uzağa savuran tekme.
words.descriptionEn: A kick that sends the target flying far.

words.description: Yer sarsılır: geniş alandaki herkes savrulur.
words.descriptionEn: The ground shakes: everyone in a wide area is flung.

words.description: Hedefin altından volkan fışkırır, her yer tutuşur.
words.descriptionEn: A volcano erupts beneath the target and everything catches fire.

words.description: Gökten buz taneleri: hasar ve yavaşlama.
words.descriptionEn: Ice pellets from the sky: damage and slowdown.

words.description: Hedefi izleyen çamur: içindekiler yavaşlar.
words.descriptionEn: Mud that follows the target: everyone inside is slowed.

words.description: Gizli zehir: basan 1 can kaybeder, yavaşlar.
words.descriptionEn: Hidden poison: whoever steps on it loses 1 life and is slowed.

words.description: Yere saçılan çiviler: basan 1 can kaybeder.
words.descriptionEn: Nails scattered on the ground: whoever steps on them loses 1 life.

words.description: Kara delik herkesi merkeze çeker.
words.descriptionEn: A black hole pulls everyone to the center.

words.description: Dev süpürge herkesi uzun süre yavaşça kendine çeker.
words.descriptionEn: A giant vacuum cleaner slowly pulls everyone toward it for a long time.

words.description: Bir sonraki darbeyi kask karşılar.
words.descriptionEn: The helmet absorbs the next hit.

words.description: Elmayı ye, 1 can kazan.
words.descriptionEn: Eat the apple, gain 1 life.

words.description: 9 saniye yavaşça uç: yerdeki tehlikeler değmez.
words.descriptionEn: Fly slowly for 9 seconds: ground hazards can't touch you.

words.description: 7 saniye hızlı uç: yerdeki tehlikeler değmez.
words.descriptionEn: Fly fast for 7 seconds: ground hazards can't touch you.

words.description: Uzun mızrak: 1 vuruş, uzaktan 2 hasar.
words.descriptionEn: Long spear: 1 strike, 2 damage from range.

words.description: 8 mermilik makineli: her isabet 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: An 8-round machine gun: each hit takes 1 life.

words.description: Dev kamyon: 2 kişiyi ezer, eve çarparsa patlar.
words.descriptionEn: A giant truck: runs over 2 people, explodes if it hits a house.

words.description: Ağır tank: 3 kişiyi ezer; eve çarpınca durur, patlamaz.
words.descriptionEn: A heavy tank: runs over 3 people; stops when it hits a house, doesn't explode.

words.description: Bisiklet: bir kişiyi ezer, sonra durur; çarpınca devrilir.
words.descriptionEn: Bicycle: runs over one person, then stops; tips over when it crashes.

words.description: Kaykay: çok hızlı, bir kişiyi ezer, sonra durur.
words.descriptionEn: Skateboard: very fast, runs over one person, then stops.

words.description: Gıdaklayan tavuk sürüsü.
words.descriptionEn: A flock of clucking chickens.

words.description: Dörtnala gelen at, çarptığını savurur.
words.descriptionEn: A galloping horse that flings whoever it rams.

words.description: Yavaş ama iri inek: savurur.
words.descriptionEn: A slow but big cow: flings you.

words.description: Hırçın yaban domuzu.
words.descriptionEn: A bad-tempered wild boar.

words.description: Toslayan keçi.
words.descriptionEn: A head-butting goat.

words.description: Zıplayan çılgın tavşan: ısırıp kaçar.
words.descriptionEn: A crazy hopping rabbit: bites and runs.

words.description: Yapışkan dilli kurbağa: yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: A sticky-tongued frog: slows you.

words.description: Hızlı kertenkele.
words.descriptionEn: A fast lizard.

words.description: Köpekbalığı: ısırığı 2 can.
words.descriptionEn: Shark: its bite costs 2 lives.

words.description: Gökten dalan karga sürüsü.
words.descriptionEn: A flock of crows diving from the sky.

words.description: Kafana konan güvercinler: yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: Pigeons landing on your head: they slow you.

words.description: Ürkünç palyaço: vurur, kaçar, yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: A creepy clown: hits, runs, slows you.

words.description: Zırhlı asker: saldırır, siper alır, yine gelir.
words.descriptionEn: An armored soldier: attacks, takes cover, comes back again.

words.description: Polis: yakalayınca kelepçeler (yavaşlatır).
words.descriptionEn: Police: cuffs whoever it catches (slows them).

words.description: Uçan uzaylı: saldırır, uzaklaşır, yine gelir.
words.descriptionEn: A flying alien: attacks, backs off, comes back again.

words.description: Kıkırdayan goblin çetesi.
words.descriptionEn: A giggling goblin gang.

words.description: Karaya çıkmış dev balina: ezer, savurur.
words.descriptionEn: A giant beached whale: crushes and flings.

words.description: Hedefe kafa atılır: savrulur.
words.descriptionEn: The target gets headbutted and is knocked away.

words.description: Hedefi izleyen tipi: içindekiler donar gibi yavaşlar.
words.descriptionEn: A blizzard that follows the target: everyone inside slows down as if freezing.

words.description: Yanan alan hedefi izler: içindekiler yanar.
words.descriptionEn: A burning area follows the target: everyone inside burns.

words.description: Yeşil gaz bulutu: öksürtür, yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: A green gas cloud: makes you cough and slows you.

words.description: Ayı kapanı: basan 1 can kaybeder, kıpırdayamaz.
words.descriptionEn: A bear trap: whoever steps in it loses 1 life and can't move.

words.description: Kaygan sabun: basan kayar, savrulur ve yavaşlar.
words.descriptionEn: Slippery soap: whoever steps on it slips, gets flung and slows down.

words.description: Kement bir anda herkesi sertçe merkeze çeker.
words.descriptionEn: The lasso instantly yanks everyone hard to the center.

words.description: 4 shuriken: Boşluk ile fırlat, her isabet 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: 4 shuriken: throw with Space, each hit takes 1 life.

words.description: Tek vuruşluk balyoz: önündekine 2 hasar.
words.descriptionEn: A one-swing sledgehammer: 2 damage to whoever is in front of you.

words.description: 2 vuruşluk tırpan: geniş yayla biçer, her vuruş 2 can.
words.descriptionEn: A 2-swing scythe: cuts in a wide arc, each hit takes 2 lives.

words.description: İki darbeyi karşılayan yelek.
words.descriptionEn: A vest that absorbs two hits.

words.description: Ye, 1 can kazan.
words.descriptionEn: Eat it, gain 1 life.

words.description: 6 saniye çok hızlı uç.
words.descriptionEn: Fly very fast for 6 seconds.

words.description: 7 saniye kimse seni hedef seçemez.
words.descriptionEn: No one can target you for 7 seconds.

words.description: Otobüs: 3 kişiyi ezer, eve çarparsa patlar.
words.descriptionEn: Bus: runs over 3 people, explodes if it hits a house.

words.description: Yavaş traktör: 2 kişiyi ezer, eve çarpınca durur.
words.descriptionEn: A slow tractor: runs over 2 people, stops when it hits a house.

words.description: Buldozer: 3 kişiyi ezer, eve çarpınca durur.
words.descriptionEn: Bulldozer: runs over 3 people, stops when it hits a house.

words.description: Hızlı go-kart: bir kişiyi ezer; eve çarparsa patlar.
words.descriptionEn: A fast go-kart: runs over one person; explodes if it hits a house.

words.description: Labirentten kaçan minotor: boynuzlarıyla savurur. Hep birlikte döv!
words.descriptionEn: A minotaur escaped from the labyrinth: flings you with its horns. Beat it up together!

words.description: Bakışı taşlaştırır: vurduğunu uzun süre yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: Her gaze turns you to stone: slows whoever she hits for a long time.

words.description: Taş golem: çok yavaş, çok sağlam.
words.descriptionEn: A stone golem: very slow, very sturdy.

words.description: Taş kanatlı gargoyle: dalar, vurur, uzaklaşır.
words.descriptionEn: A stone-winged gargoyle: dives, strikes, flies off.

words.description: Dev fil: yavaş ama 2 can götürür ve savurur.
words.descriptionEn: A giant elephant: slow, but takes 2 lives and flings you.

words.description: Buz devrinden gelen mamut. Son vuran can kazanır.
words.descriptionEn: A mammoth from the Ice Age. The last hitter gains a life.

words.description: Üç çakal: vur-kaç yaparak saldırır.
words.descriptionEn: Three jackals: they attack with hit-and-run.

words.description: Gülen sırtlan: ısırır, kaçar.
words.descriptionEn: A laughing hyena: bites and runs.

words.description: Paytak penguen sürüsü.
words.descriptionEn: A waddling flock of penguins.

words.description: Yapışkan sümüklüböcek: değdiğini uzun süre yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: A sticky slug: slows whoever it touches for a long time.

words.description: Topraktan fışkıran solucanlar.
words.descriptionEn: Worms bursting out of the ground.

words.description: Süzülen denizanası: çarpar, uyuşturur.
words.descriptionEn: A drifting jellyfish: stings and numbs you.

words.description: Tarih öncesi uçan sürüngen: dalıp vurur.
words.descriptionEn: A prehistoric flying reptile: dives and strikes.

words.description: Sinsi hırsız: vurur ve kaçar.
words.descriptionEn: A sneaky thief: hits and runs.

words.description: Gökten top güllesi iner: 2 can ve savrulma.
words.descriptionEn: A cannonball drops from the sky: 2 lives and knockback.

words.description: Rengarenk patlar, çevresini tutuşturur.
words.descriptionEn: Bursts in every color and sets its surroundings on fire.

words.description: Sert rüzgâr: geniş alandakileri savurur (hasar yok).
words.descriptionEn: A strong wind: flings everyone in a wide area (no damage).

words.description: Hedefi izleyen radyasyon: içindekiler yanar.
words.descriptionEn: Radiation that follows the target: everyone inside burns.

words.description: Yere saçılmış lego: basan 1 can kaybeder (ve bağırır).
words.descriptionEn: Lego scattered on the floor: whoever steps on it loses 1 life (and screams).

words.description: Basan yapışır: 5 saniye yavaşlar.
words.descriptionEn: Whoever steps on it gets stuck: slowed for 5 seconds.

words.description: Gizli kum çukuru: batan 1 can kaybeder, yavaşlar.
words.descriptionEn: A hidden quicksand pit: whoever sinks in loses 1 life and is slowed.

words.description: 2 oklu arbalet: her isabet 2 can.
words.descriptionEn: A 2-bolt crossbow: each hit takes 2 lives.

words.description: 4 vuruşluk tava: her vuruş 1 can (ve güzel bir ses).
words.descriptionEn: A 4-swing frying pan: each hit takes 1 life (and makes a lovely sound).

words.description: Uzun kamçı: uzaktan 4 vuruş, her biri 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: A long whip: 4 strikes from a distance, each takes 1 life.

words.description: 6 vuruşluk nunçaku: hızlı ve 1'er can.
words.descriptionEn: A 6-swing nunchaku: fast, 1 life per hit.

words.description: 2 vuruşluk ışın kılıcı: her vuruş 2 hasar, savurmadan önce parlar.
words.descriptionEn: A 2-swing laser sword: each swing deals 2 damage and glows before it lands.

words.description: Nazar değmez: bir sonraki darbeyi engeller.
words.descriptionEn: Safe from the evil eye: blocks the next hit.

words.description: Ayna bir darbeyi geri seker (engeller).
words.descriptionEn: The mirror bounces back one hit (blocks it).

words.description: Tatlı bir şey ye, 1 can kazan.
words.descriptionEn: Eat something sweet, gain 1 life.

words.description: 7 saniye süzül: yerdeki tehlikeler değmez.
words.descriptionEn: Glide for 7 seconds: ground hazards can't touch you.

words.description: 8 saniye halıyla uç.
words.descriptionEn: Fly on a carpet for 8 seconds.

words.description: 5 saniyelik dev zıplama: altından her şey geçer.
words.descriptionEn: A giant 5-second bounce: everything passes beneath you.

words.description: Önüne 5 birimlik buz duvarı dikersin.
words.descriptionEn: You raise a 5-unit ice wall in front of you.

words.description: Siren çalan ambulans: bir kişiyi ezer, eve çarparsa patlar.
words.descriptionEn: An ambulance with its siren wailing: runs over one person, explodes if it hits a house.

words.description: Durdurulamaz tren: 3 kişiyi ezer, eve çarparsa patlar.
words.descriptionEn: An unstoppable train: runs over 3 people, explodes if it hits a house.

words.description: Uzun limuzin: 2 kişiyi ezer.
words.descriptionEn: A long limousine: runs over 2 people.

words.description: At arabası: 2 kişiyi ezer, eve çarpınca durur.
words.descriptionEn: Horse carriage: runs over 2 people, stops when it hits a house.

words.description: 7 saniye uçan daireyle uç.
words.descriptionEn: Fly a flying saucer for 7 seconds.

words.description: Kurnaz tilki: ısırır, kaçar, yine gelir.
words.descriptionEn: A cunning fox: bites, runs off, comes back again.

words.description: Sessiz kanatlı baykuş: süzülüp vurur.
words.descriptionEn: A silent-winged owl: glides in and strikes.

words.description: Çılgın sincap çetesi.
words.descriptionEn: A crazy gang of squirrels.

words.description: Zırhlı yengeç: kıskacıyla tutar, yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: An armored crab: grabs you with its claws and slows you.

words.description: Huysuz deve: tükürür (yavaşlatır), savurur.
words.descriptionEn: A grumpy camel: spits (slows you) and flings you.

words.description: Boksör kanguru: zıplayıp tekmeler.
words.descriptionEn: A boxing kangaroo: hops and kicks.

words.description: Tombul panda: yavaş ama sağlam.
words.descriptionEn: A chubby panda: slow but sturdy.

words.description: Dikenli kirpi: batırır, yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: A spiky hedgehog: pricks you and slows you.

words.description: Elektrikli yılan balığı: çarpar, uyuşturur.
words.descriptionEn: An electric eel: shocks and numbs you.

words.description: Ölümsüz köpek: hızlı ve durmaz.
words.descriptionEn: An undead dog: fast and relentless.

words.description: Baltalı viking: vurur, savurur, geri çekilir.
words.descriptionEn: An axe-wielding viking: strikes, flings, pulls back.

words.description: Zırhlı gladyatör.
words.descriptionEn: An armored gladiator.

words.description: Dev sumocu: göbeğiyle savurur.
words.descriptionEn: A giant sumo wrestler: flings you with his belly.

words.description: Hızlı boksör: yumruk yağdırır, savurur.
words.descriptionEn: A fast boxer: rains down punches and flings you.

words.description: Kayarak dalan futbolcu: savurur.
words.descriptionEn: A footballer who slide-tackles: flings you.

words.description: Kepçeli aşçı: vurur, yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: A ladle-wielding cook: hits you and slows you.

words.description: Topraktan fışkıran dev solucan.
words.descriptionEn: A giant worm bursting out of the ground.

words.description: Gökten örs düşer: 2 can!
words.descriptionEn: An anvil falls from the sky: 2 lives!

words.description: Tepeden piyano iner: 2 can ve savrulma.
words.descriptionEn: A piano drops from above: 2 lives and knockback.

words.description: Balkondan saksı düşer.
words.descriptionEn: A flowerpot falls from a balcony.

words.description: Suratına top gelir: 1 can ve savrulma.
words.descriptionEn: A ball hits you in the face: 1 life and knockback.

words.description: Hedefi izleyen lav seli: içindekiler yanar.
words.descriptionEn: A lava flow that follows the target: everyone inside burns.

words.description: Sürpriz kutu: açan 1 can kaybeder, savrulur.
words.descriptionEn: A surprise box: whoever opens it loses 1 life and is flung.

words.description: Buzlu zemin: basan kayar, savrulur.
words.descriptionEn: Icy ground: whoever steps on it slips and is flung.

words.description: UFO ışını herkesi merkeze çeker.
words.descriptionEn: A UFO beam pulls everyone to the center.

words.description: 6 yumurta: Boşluk ile fırlat, her isabet 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: 6 eggs: throw with Space, each hit takes 1 life.

words.description: 4 çürük domates: her isabet 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: 4 rotten tomatoes: each hit takes 1 life.

words.description: 5 büyü: Boşluk ile ateş et, her isabet 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: 5 spells: fire with Space, each hit takes 1 life.

words.description: 4 vuruşluk kürek: her vuruş 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: A 4-swing shovel: each hit takes 1 life.

words.description: 25 saniye boyunca iki darbeyi engeller.
words.descriptionEn: Blocks two hits for 25 seconds.

words.description: Bir yudum: 1 can kazanırsın.
words.descriptionEn: One sip: you gain 1 life.

words.description: 7 saniye süpürgeyle uç.
words.descriptionEn: Fly on a broom for 7 seconds.

words.description: 8 saniye kanatlı atla uç.
words.descriptionEn: Fly on a winged horse for 8 seconds.

words.description: Önüne sağlam bir taş duvar örersin.
words.descriptionEn: You build a sturdy stone wall in front of you.

words.description: Sireniyle polis arabası: bir kişiyi ezer, sonra durur.
words.descriptionEn: A police car with its siren on: runs over one person, then stops.

words.description: Kızak: kayıp bir kişiyi ezer, sonra durur.
words.descriptionEn: Sled: slides along, runs over one person, then stops.

words.description: Jet ski: çok hızlı, bir kişiyi ezer; eve çarparsa patlar.
words.descriptionEn: Jet ski: very fast, runs over one person; explodes if it hits a house.

words.description: Dev yengeç: kıskaçlarıyla yavaşlatır. Hep birlikte döv!
words.descriptionEn: A giant crab: slows you with its claws. Beat it up together!

words.description: Yuvarlanan bowling topu: 2 can, savrulma.
words.descriptionEn: A rolling bowling ball: 2 lives and knockback.

words.description: Hedefi izleyen kara bulut: içindekiler yavaşlar.
words.descriptionEn: A dark cloud that follows the target: everyone inside is slowed.

words.description: 4 su balonu: her isabet 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: 4 water balloons: each hit takes 1 life.

words.description: 8 sn sonra güneş patlar: mağarada olmayan herkes elenir.
words.descriptionEn: After 8 s the sun erupts: everyone not in a cave is eliminated.

words.description: 8 sn sonra her şey donar: sığınakta olmayan elenir.
words.descriptionEn: After 8 s everything freezes: anyone not in the shelter is eliminated.

words.description: 7 sn sonra zehirli bulut çöker: sığınağa gir!
words.descriptionEn: After 7 s a toxic cloud settles in: get into the shelter!

words.description: 8 sn sonra volkan patlar: mağaraya sığın!
words.descriptionEn: After 8 s the volcano erupts: take cover in a cave!

words.description: Baraj yıkıldı: dev su dalgası geliyor, kuleye çık!
words.descriptionEn: The dam has collapsed: a giant wave is coming, climb a tower!

words.description: Gökten asit damlaları: gölgeleri gör, kaç.
words.descriptionEn: Acid drops from the sky: watch the shadows and run.

words.description: Uçaklar bomba yağdırıyor: düşecekleri yerde gölge belirir.
words.descriptionEn: Planes are raining bombs: shadows appear where they will land.

words.description: Gökyüzü oklarla kararıyor: gölgelerden uzak dur.
words.descriptionEn: The sky goes dark with arrows: stay away from the shadows.

words.description: 24 çekirge her yerden saldırır (9 sn): evlere sığın.
words.descriptionEn: 24 locusts attack from everywhere (9 s): hide in the houses.

words.description: 18 fare kenarlardan akın eder: evlere sığın.
words.descriptionEn: 18 rats pour in from the edges: hide in the houses.

words.description: 16 iskelet mezardan kalkar (12 sn): evlere sığın.
words.descriptionEn: 16 skeletons rise from their graves (12 s): hide in the houses.

words.description: 12 uzaylı gökten iner: mağaralara sığın.
words.descriptionEn: 12 aliens descend from the sky: hide in the caves.

words.description: 12 robot yavaş ama durmadan ilerler: evlere sığın.
words.descriptionEn: 12 robots advance slowly but relentlessly: hide in the houses.

words.description: Alevden kuş 10 sn en yakındakini kovalar, ateş saçar: mağaraya sığın.
words.descriptionEn: A bird of flame chases the nearest player for 10 s, spraying fire: take cover in a cave.

words.description: Yanan dev yürür, çevresini yakar (12 sn): mağaraya sığın.
words.descriptionEn: A burning giant walks around, setting everything near it on fire (12 s): take cover in a cave.

words.description: 8 saniye kutuya saklan: kimse seni hedef seçemez.
words.descriptionEn: Hide in a box for 8 seconds: no one can target you.

words.description: Sis bombası: 5 saniye kaybolursun.
words.descriptionEn: Smoke bomb: you vanish for 5 seconds.

words.description: Önüne kum torbası siperi dizersin.
words.descriptionEn: You stack a sandbag barricade in front of you.

words.description: Elenenlerden biri küllerinden doğar (1 canla döner).
words.descriptionEn: One of the eliminated players rises from the ashes (returns with 1 life).

words.description: 16 örümcek ağlarıyla yavaşlatır: mağaralara sığın.
words.descriptionEn: 16 spiders slow you with their webs: hide in the caves.

words.description: 8 saniye çalılığa dönüşürsün: kimse seni hedef seçemez.
words.descriptionEn: You turn into a bush for 8 seconds: no one can target you.

words.description: 9 saniye kayaya dönüşürsün: kimse seni hedef seçemez.
words.descriptionEn: You turn into a rock for 9 seconds: no one can target you.

words.description: 7 saniye saksıya dönüşürsün: kimse fark etmez.
words.descriptionEn: You turn into a flowerpot for 7 seconds: no one notices.

words.description: Uzun süren tek darbelik kalkan.
words.descriptionEn: A long-lasting shield that blocks one hit.

words.description: 12 saniye boyunca üç darbeyi engeller, sonra erir.
words.descriptionEn: Blocks three hits for 12 seconds, then melts.

words.description: Sıcak çorba: 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: Hot soup: 1 life.

words.description: Soğuk ayran: 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: Cold ayran (yogurt drink): 1 life.

words.description: Bir dilim baklava: 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: A slice of baklava: 1 life.

words.description: Lokum ye: 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: Eat some Turkish delight: 1 life.

words.description: Simit ye: 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: Eat a simit (sesame bread ring): 1 life.

words.description: Serin karpuz: 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: Cool watermelon: 1 life.

words.description: Yaranı sar: 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: Wrap your wound: 1 life.

words.description: 9 saniye beyaz kanatlarla uç.
words.descriptionEn: Fly on white wings for 9 seconds.

words.description: 6 saniye yerden yüksekte süzül.
words.descriptionEn: Glide high above the ground for 6 seconds.

words.description: Önüne kısa ama sağlam bir çelik kapı dikersin.
words.descriptionEn: You put up a short but sturdy steel door in front of you.

words.description: Elenenlerden biri 1 canla geri döner.
words.descriptionEn: One of the eliminated players comes back with 1 life.

words.description: 16 goblin kıkırdayarak saldırır: mağaralara sığın.
words.descriptionEn: 16 goblins attack, giggling: hide in the caves.

words.description: 12 korsan kıyıdan çıkar: evlere sığın.
words.descriptionEn: 12 pirates come ashore: hide in the houses.

words.description: 10 hızlı ninja: mağaralara sığın.
words.descriptionEn: 10 fast ninjas: hide in the caves.

words.description: 14 vampir yarasa gece çöker: evlere sığın.
words.descriptionEn: 14 vampires swoop down in the night: hide in the houses.

words.description: 9 sn sonra dev meteor çarpar: sığınağa gir!
words.descriptionEn: After 9 s a giant meteor hits: get into the shelter!

words.description: Boynuzlu geyik dörtnala dalar, çarptığını savurur.
words.descriptionEn: An antlered deer charges at a gallop, flinging whoever it rams.

words.description: 4 yaramaz maymun her yandan atlar, 1'er can alır.
words.descriptionEn: 4 mischievous monkeys leap in from every side, taking 1 life each.

words.description: Kulağına bağıran papağan: can almaz ama yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: A parrot screaming in your ear: takes no lives but slows you.

words.description: Çok yavaş ama koca su aygırı: değerse 2 can ve savrulma.
words.descriptionEn: A very slow but huge hippo: if it touches you, 2 lives and knockback.

words.description: 3 yaramaz peri büyü tozu serper: can almaz, yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: 3 mischievous fairies sprinkle magic dust: takes no lives, but slows you.

words.description: Çok başlı dev yılan: ısırdığını yavaşlatır. 14 vuruşta yenilir, son vuran +1 can.
words.descriptionEn: A giant many-headed serpent: slows whoever it bites. Defeated in 14 hits; the last hitter gains +1 life.

words.description: Üç başlı dev köpek: hızlı koşar, savurur. 10 vuruşta yenilir.
words.descriptionEn: A giant three-headed dog: runs fast and flings you. Defeated in 10 hits.

words.description: Kovboy: dalar, vurur, kaçar, yine gelir.
words.descriptionEn: Cowboy: charges in, strikes, runs off, comes back again.

words.description: İnatçı eşek çifte atar: 1 can ve savrulma.
words.descriptionEn: A stubborn donkey kicks with both hind legs: 1 life and knockback.

words.description: Palmiyeden hindistan cevizi düşer: gölgesinden kaç.
words.descriptionEn: A coconut falls from a palm tree: run from its shadow.

words.description: Tepeden dev kaya iner: 2 can ve savrulma, ama uyarısı uzun.
words.descriptionEn: A giant boulder drops from above: 2 lives and knockback, but with a long warning.

words.description: Hedefin yanına kırmızı varil düşer, 3 sn sonra patlar.
words.descriptionEn: A red barrel lands next to the target and explodes after 3 s.

words.description: Hedefin yanında kaktüs biter: değen 1 can kaybeder.
words.descriptionEn: A cactus sprouts next to the target: whoever touches it loses 1 life.

words.description: Yere saçılan bilyeler: basan kayar, savrulur, yavaşlar.
words.descriptionEn: Marbles scattered on the ground: whoever steps on them slips, gets flung and slows down.

words.description: Dev bir hapşırık hedefi uçurur (hasar yok).
words.descriptionEn: A giant sneeze sends the target flying (no damage).

words.description: Kulak patlatan çığlık: çevredeki herkes savrulur (hasar yok).
words.descriptionEn: An ear-splitting scream: everyone nearby is flung (no damage).

words.description: Yerçekimi bozulur: herkes 5 sn merkeze çekilir.
words.descriptionEn: Gravity goes haywire: everyone is pulled to the center for 5 s.

words.description: 5 vuruşluk yastık: Boşluk ile vur, her vuruş 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: A 5-swing pillow: hit with Space, each hit takes 1 life.

words.description: 6 fışkırtmalık su tabancası: her isabet 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: A 6-squirt water gun: each hit takes 1 life.

words.description: 2 iri taş fırlat: yavaş gider ama her isabet 2 can.
words.descriptionEn: Hurl 2 big rocks: they fly slowly, but each hit takes 2 lives.

words.description: Uzun yaba: 1 vuruş, uzaktan 2 hasar (kalkan korur).
words.descriptionEn: Long pitchfork: 1 strike, 2 damage from range (a shield protects).

words.description: 5 dart oku: küçük ama hızlı, her isabet 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: 5 darts: small but fast, each hit takes 1 life.

words.description: Şemsiyeni aç: bir sonraki darbeyi engeller.
words.descriptionEn: Open your umbrella: blocks the next hit.

words.description: Ağır demir zırh: iki darbeyi karşılar.
words.descriptionEn: Heavy iron armor: absorbs two hits.

words.description: Yoğurtlu mantı: 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: Manti (dumplings) with yogurt: 1 life.

words.description: Sıcak kebap: 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: Hot kebab: 1 life.

words.description: Bir külah dondurma: 1 can.
words.descriptionEn: An ice cream cone: 1 life.

words.description: 9 saniye zeplinle yavaşça süzül: yerdeki tehlikeler değmez.
words.descriptionEn: Drift slowly in a zeppelin for 9 seconds: ground hazards can't touch you.

words.description: 7 saniye dev uçurtmayla havalan.
words.descriptionEn: Take to the air on a giant kite for 7 seconds.

words.description: 8 saniye çöp kutusuna dönüşürsün: kimse seni hedef seçemez.
words.descriptionEn: You turn into a trash can for 8 seconds: no one can target you.

words.description: 8 saniye kardan adam gibi dur: kimse seni hedef seçemez.
words.descriptionEn: Stand still like a snowman for 8 seconds: no one can target you.

words.description: 9 saniye ağaca dönüşürsün: kimse seni hedef seçemez.
words.descriptionEn: You turn into a tree for 9 seconds: no one can target you.

words.description: Önüne uzun ama kısa ömürlü bir tahta perde çakarsın.
words.descriptionEn: You nail up a long but short-lived wooden barrier in front of you.

words.description: Kedi gibi dokuz canlısın: elenenlerden biri 1 canla geri döner.
words.descriptionEn: You have nine lives like a cat: one of the eliminated players returns with 1 life.

words.description: Küçük golf arabası: bir kişiyi ezer, sonra durur. Eve çarparsan patlarsın!
words.descriptionEn: A small golf cart: runs over one person, then stops. Crash into a house and you explode!

words.description: Yavaş forklift: 2 kişiyi ezer, eve çarpınca durur, patlamaz.
words.descriptionEn: A slow forklift: runs over 2 people; stops when it hits a house, doesn't explode.

words.description: 14 kurt gece ulur ve saldırır (9 sn): evlere sığın.
words.descriptionEn: 14 wolves howl in the night and attack (9 s): hide in the houses.

words.description: Yıldırımlar yağıyor: düşecekleri yerde gölge belirir, uzak dur.
words.descriptionEn: Lightning is striking: shadows appear where it will hit, stay away.

words.description: 8 sn sonra salgın yayılır: sığınakta olmayan herkes elenir.
words.descriptionEn: After 8 s the outbreak spreads: everyone not in the shelter is eliminated.

words.description: Harita su basar, 12 köpekbalığı yüzer (9 sn): kuleye çık!
words.descriptionEn: The map floods and 12 sharks swim in (9 s): climb a tower!

words.description: 22 katil arı her yerden saldırır (8 sn): evlere sığın.
words.descriptionEn: 22 killer bees attack from everywhere (8 s): hide in the houses.

words.description: 14 mumya kumdan kalkar, yavaş ama durmaz (14 sn): evlere sığın.
words.descriptionEn: 14 mummies rise from the sand, slow but relentless (14 s): hide in the houses.

words.description: Uydu parçaları yağıyor: düşecekleri yerde gölge belirir, kaç.
words.descriptionEn: Satellite debris is raining down: shadows appear where it will land, run.

words.description: 8 sn sonra uzaydan ışın çarpar: mağarada olmayan herkes elenir.
words.descriptionEn: After 8 s a ray from space strikes: everyone not in a cave is eliminated.

words.description: Dişlek kunduz: kemirir, 1 can alır ve yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: A buck-toothed beaver: gnaws, takes 1 life and slows you.

words.description: Koca gagalı pelikan: pike yapar, vurur, uzaklaşır.
words.descriptionEn: A big-billed pelican: dives, strikes, flies off.

words.description: Kış gecesi çıkan tüylü yaratık: vurduğunu üşütüp yavaşlatır.
words.descriptionEn: A furry creature that comes out on winter nights: chills whoever it hits and slows them.

words.description: 3 terlik: Boşluk ile fırlat, her isabet 1 can (anne usulü).
words.descriptionEn: 3 slippers: throw with Space, each hit takes 1 life (mom style).

words.description: İnen var! Dolmuş 2 kişiyi ezer; eve çarparsa patlar.
words.descriptionEn: Stop here, please! The shared taxi runs over 2 people; explodes if it hits a house.

words.description: 9 sn sonra Ay yere çarpar: sığınakta olmayan herkes elenir.
words.descriptionEn: After 9 s the Moon crashes into the ground: everyone not in the shelter is eliminated.

words.description: 24 karınca topraktan fışkırır, yavaş ama her yerden gelir (12 sn): evlere sığın.
words.descriptionEn: 24 ants burst out of the ground, slow but coming from everywhere (12 s): hide in the houses.
